title: Iceland votes against restarting EU membership talks
content: Broadcaster RUV reports that 52.8% of voters rejected the government's proposal to resume accession talks.

title: Manhunt after shooting at Swiss rave kills woman, 22, and injures five
content: Five others in their twenties were injured after shots were fired at a techno event near Zurich.

title: Canada installs large Lake Ontario sign in latest jab at US
content: Ontario Premier Doug Ford unveiled a billboard on Canada's shoreline with the message: "Lake Ontario. Now and Always."

title: Trump threatens to report journalist Kristen Welker to broadcast regulator
content: The Federal Communications Commission under Trump has tried to target news outlets for spreading 'fake' news.

title: Zambia opposition leader Brian Mundubile charged with treason
content: Zambian opposition leader Brian Mundubile and his running mate, Makebi Zulu, have been charged with treason.

title: Death toll nears 800 after Himalayan glacier collapse
content: Specialised search-and-rescue teams join recovery operations in Nepal and China.
